description: Oaxaca-Blinder-type decomposition of the change in the fatal (KA) share between 2016-19 and 2020-24 into composition and within-circumstance effects (both references and their average), plus sensitivity analyses
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 with known maximum severity
method: Survey-weighted (pseudo-ML) logistic models, ridge 0.01; predictive margins; Taylor linearisation with coefficient influence, summed within 67 PSUs / 25 strata; t with 42 df; separate period models; cross-period predictive margins

covariate_sets.B: pre-crash circumstances + crash configuration (crash type, vehicles)
